handoff: Approve: slice 03 meets AC1-AC6; paths via store constants, messages name the new paths (D11), layout.test.ts covers AC1-AC5. Targeted tests 118/118, typecheck green. Minor: process.test.ts fallback keys on .agents/norn/ instead of its config file; nit for slice 07: assets/config.yaml header names old paths.

findings.title: Old-layout fallback keys on the folder, not the files it copies
findings.detail:
CONFIG_ROOT = existsSync(OLD_DIR) ? newLayoutCopy() : ROOT, and newLayoutCopy copies .agents/norn/config.yaml and workflows/. Once this repo is migrated but a checkout still holds the gitignored .agents/norn/trace/ (until slice 04 lands, or a stale local trace), OLD_DIR exists, cpSync throws ENOENT and the whole file fails to load. The temp copy is also never removed.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Test existsSync(join(OLD_DIR, "config.yaml")) instead of OLD_DIR.

findings.title: The config file init writes still names the old paths in its header
findings.detail:
init now writes this asset to .agents/norn.config.yaml, but its comments say `# norn repo config: .agents/norn/config.yaml` and `Workflows in .agents/norn/workflows/`, so the file a person opens after AC6 names the old layout. Slice 07 AC2 owns packages/cli/assets text, so this is in scope there, not here; noted so it is not lost.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Leave to slice 07 (its AC2 scan covers packages/cli/assets).
